title: Stone Hand Iron Fever (拳痴 铁狂) - Location, Tactics & Rewards
description: Stone Hand Iron Fever (拳痴 铁狂) in Phantom Blade Zero - where the fight happens, what it drops, and how its attack patterns are countered, including the red and blue flash tells.
keyword: Stone Hand Iron Fever (拳痴 铁狂) phantom blade zero boss

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Stone Hand Iron Fever (拳痴 铁狂) is an optional encounter in Crimson Manor & Crimson Forest, found at Crimson Forest. Beating it yields Iron Gauntlets.

sections.title: Where to Find the Stone Hand Iron Fever (拳痴 铁狂)
sections.content:
Location: Crimson Forest.

Appears in: Crimson Manor & Crimson Forest.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It is optional, which is why it can be left until the Sha-Chi pool and the Phantom Edge roster are deeper.

sections.title: How to Beat the Stone Hand Iron Fever (拳痴 铁狂)
sections.content:
What works

  • Break his guard instead of trading - he is built to outlast chip damage.
  • Reward is the Iron Gauntlets, which change how the next few fights feel.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 12 of 60 in the progression order, in Crimson Manor & Crimson Forest. Before it: Jing Ye, the Outlaw (亡命徒 荆野). After it: Bai Chilian, Lady of the Twin Serpents (双蛇夫人 白赤练). The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
